95f622e306aa23ce3678e6c5aba0dfec8f303bf3.code:
N           ← ⋕◇∘⊡1 &args
Widths      ← ⇌+2⇡-1N
Divisors    ← ⇌↙-1N \×+1⇡N
Total       ← /×+1⇡N
Rotate      ← ↯⊃(⋅△)(⊏⊃(♭+⊃(⋅(×N⇡⧻))(+⊙(¤⇡N) ×⊃(¤<⊃⊢(⋅(⇡N)))(-⊃(⋅(¤⇡N))(◿⊃⊢(⊞+⊃(↘1)(⋅(⇡N)))))))(⋅♭))
Permutation ← ∧Rotate ⊃(≡⊂ Widths ◿(≡¤ Widths)⌊⊞÷ Divisors)(↯⊃(⊂⊃⧻(⋅N))(⋅(⇡N)))
FlipIndices ← +⊙(¤⇡N) ×⊃(⊞≤ ⊙(⇡N))(⊞˜- ⊙(×2⇡N))
~FlipState {Permutations Counts}
FlipStep ← FlipState ⊃(≡⊏ ⊃(FlipIndices ≡⊢FlipState.Permutations)FlipState.Permutations|+⊃FlipState.Counts(>0≡⊢FlipState.Permutations))
Flips    ← FlipState.Counts ⍢(FlipStep|/↥>0≡⊢FlipState.Permutations) FlipState ⊃(∘|↯⊃(⧻|⋅0))
~F {Index End Checksum Maximum}
~Ranks {State Indices}
~Block {State Indices Counts}
BlockIndices ← +⊃F.Index(⇡↧1024 -⊃(F.Index|F.End))
Ranked       ← Ranks ⊃(∘|BlockIndices)
Candidate    ← Block ⊃(Ranks.State|Ranks.Indices|Flips Permutation Ranks.Indices) Ranked
Work         ← F ⊃(+⊃(F.Index Block.State)(⧻Block.Indices)|F.End Block.State|+⊃(F.Checksum Block.State)(/+×⊃(˜ⁿ¯1Block.Indices)Block.Counts)|↥⊃(F.Maximum Block.State)(/↥Block.Counts)) Candidate
Result       ← ≡°□ wait ≡spawn(□ ⍢(Work|<⊃F.End F.Index) F ⊃(⊢|⊣|⋅0|⋅0)) ⍉⊟ ⊃(↙↧8Total)(↘1) ⌊÷↧8Total ×Total⇡+1↧8Total
&p /+ ≡F.Checksum Result
&p $"Pfannkuchen(_) = _" N /↥ ≡F.Maximum Result

fannkuchredux:parallel-study:uiua-compac.source_provenance: Locally authored isolated Uiua source using pure composition of the ordinary array/block and spawn/wait operations qualified by v4.
adaptations: Whole-block numeric-stage factoradic gather; explicit at-most-eight disjoint global-rank workers.
fannkuchredux:parallel-study:uiua-compac.timing_boundary: Three actual fresh N12 processes per profile. All 479001600 global ranks are materialized, every actual prefix reversal finishes, checksum uses global parity. Whole-process timing includes startup, source compilation where applicable, explicit worker startup/join, complete output and shutdown. Hashing, qualification and pin checks are excluded.

runtime.provenance: Official Uiua ARM64 macOS release binary; not a locally compiled substitute.
runtime.system_library_policy: macOS platform libraries are supplied by the recorded host OS; no additional non-system runtime dylib is linked by Uiua.

algorithm.reason: The Mech program enumerates all factorial permutations in the required factoradic order, performs actual prefix flips, and reduces the alternating checksum and maximum. Parallel ranges cover the full permutation domain.
